src: 3x3 blue/background lattice cells plus one 6x6 accent instruction region
transform: decode the instruction as a 3x3 mask; in every 3x3 cell where all mask positions are blue, recolor those positions to the accent color and leave other pixels unchanged
symbol_instructions: each solid 2x2 accent block in the 6x6 instruction region marks the corresponding pixel of the 3x3 mask
